extraction.Name: Wm. Grant
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I was going to pay the taxes due (one year) but he said he would pay the taxes; I had $300.00 in the Crookston State Bank and they took $87.36 of my money to pay for the taxes
extraction.NOTES: Document appears to be a partial/fragment. Affiant references a note for $500.00 and a promised additional $200.00 from an unnamed party, neither of which were received. The Crookston State Bank held $300.00 of affiant's money and deducted $87.36 for taxes; affiant received only a tax receipt when inquiring about the remaining balance.
